question: **Choose the correctly spelt word:**
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Abeyance .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abeyance"** is correctly spelt and means a state of temporary disuse or suspension.
 
• Option 1 (**Abyeance**) is incorrect as it is misspelt.
 
• Option 3 (**Abeeyance**) is incorrect as it contains an extra 'e'.
 
• Option 4 (**Abyeence**) is incorrect as it is also misspelt.

Correct usage: *The project was held in **abeyance** due to unforeseen circumstances.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Abeyance:**
 
 
• **Meaning:** A state of temporary inactivity or suspension.
 
• **Origin:** Derived from the Old French word "abeance," meaning expectation or longing.
 
• **Example:** The court case was in abeyance pending further investigation.
